purpose: Measure whether the 2,000 prompt-injection/refusal examples, rather than short-answer SFT generally, drive the Attempt-1 capability collapse. The only manipulated variable is the training corpus.

downstream_of.relationship: This ablation is explicitly downstream of finalized Attempt-1 evidence. The loader fails closed if the frozen manifest digest changes.

authorization.statement: The issue #31 body authorizes this separately versioned ablation in writing. It is an authorized deviation being executed, not a protocol decision being made.

baseline.justification: Model identity, model revision, evaluation suite, fixed example identifiers, decoding block and scorers are unchanged. The corpus is the only manipulated variable, so no fresh baseline evaluation is run.

unchanged: visible evaluation suites and fixed identifiers

corpus.source_cache: Re-fetched and verified against Attempt-1 on 2026-09-02; every source is available under HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1.
corpus.acceptance: Exactly 5,000 examples, no category shortfall, and zero prompt_injection examples. The 1,536-token construction filter is deliberately below the frozen 2,048-token trainer limit so every retained response remains trainable without changing trainer truncation behavior. Report the raw source pool sizes and canonical Dolly-row digest.

recovery.acceptance: Deliberately terminate epoch 1 after a durable checkpoint, rerun the identical command, and retain mid_epoch_resume_fired plus save measurements in the attempt ledger.

analysis.comparison: paired per-benchmark comparison against completed seed 42; distinct from frozen Attempt-1 bootstrap seed 271828

boundaries: Outputs are stored under ablation/ outside runs/ and analysis/ and never enter an Attempt-1 evidence bundle.
The ablation never feeds checkpoint selection and never contributes to the frozen Attempt-1 bootstrap.
The held-out InjecAgent benchmark is untouched; no held-out sealer or restricted root is constructed or read.
GPU-hours are recorded on the ablation protocol resource line and included only in combined all-incurred compute accounting.
The ablation determines whether the injection block is responsible, not whether injection semantics or repeated refusals cause any effect.
